categories.name: قَبَائِلُ قَدِيمَةٌ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Ancient Tribes Mentioned in the Quran

items.verse: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
items.verseEn: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

items.verse: أَلَمْ يَأْتِهِمْ نَبَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٍۢ وَثَمُودَ وَقَوْمِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَأَصْحَـٰبِ مَدْيَنَ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتِ ۚ أَتَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
items.verseEn: Has there not reached them the news of those before them - the people of Noah and [the tribes of] ʿAad and Thamūd and the people of Abraham and the companions [i.e., dwellers] of Madyan and the towns overturned? Their messengers came to them with clear proofs. And Allāh would never have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves.
And the companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] were [also] wrongdoers,

categories.name: صِفَاتُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي سُورَةِ التَّوْبَةِ
categories.nameEn: Characteristics of the Believers in Surah At-Tawbah

items.verse: ٱلتَّـٰٓئِبُونَ ٱلْعَـٰبِدُونَ ٱلْحَـٰمِدُونَ ٱلسَّـٰٓئِحُونَ ٱلرَّٰكِعُونَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدُونَ ٱلْـَٔامِرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَٱلنَّاهُونَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱلْحَـٰفِظُونَ لِحُدُودِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
items.verseEn: [Such believers are] the repentant, the worshippers, the praisers [of Allāh], the travelers [for His cause], those who bow and prostrate [in prayer], those who enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong, and those who observe the limits [set by] Allāh. And give good tidings to the believers.

items.verse: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَـٰهَدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
items.verseEn: The ones who have believed, emigrated and striven in the cause of Allāh with their wealth and their lives are greater in rank in the sight of Allāh. And it is those who are the attainers [of success].

items.verse: وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتُ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ يَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَيُطِيعُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ سَيَرْحَمُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
items.verseEn: The believing men and believing women are allies of one another. They enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and establish prayer and give zakāh and obey Allāh and His Messenger. Those - Allāh will have mercy upon them. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.

items.verse: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قَـٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يَلُونَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ وَلْيَجِدُوا۟ فِيكُمْ غِلْظَةًۭ ۚ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
items.verseEn: O you who have believed, fight against those adjacent to you of the disbelievers and let them find in you harshness. And know that Allāh is with the righteous.

categories.name: مُصْطَلَحَاتٌ مِنْ قِصَّةِ ذِي الْقَرْنَيْنِ
categories.nameEn: Key Terms from the Story of Dhul-Qarnayn in Surah Al-Kahf

items.verse: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَن ذِى ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ ۖ قُلْ سَأَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْهُ ذِكْرًا
items.verseEn: And they ask you, [O Muḥammad], about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say, "I will recite to you about him a report."

items.verse: قَالَ أَمَّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوْفَ نُعَذِّبُهُۥ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ فَيُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابًۭا نُّكْرًۭا
items.verseEn: He said, "As for one who wrongs, we will punish him. Then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment [i.e., Hellfire].

items.verse: وَأَمَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا فَلَهُۥ جَزَآءً ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِنَا يُسْرًۭا
items.verseEn: But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of the best [i.e., Paradise], and we [i.e., Dhul-Qarnayn] will speak to him from our command with ease."

items.verse: كَذَٰلِكَ وَقَدْ أَحَطْنَا بِمَا لَدَيْهِ خُبْرًۭا
items.verseEn: Thus. And We had encompassed [all] that he had in knowledge.

categories.name: مُفْرَدَاتٌ مِنْ قِصَّةِ نُوحٍ فِي سُورَةِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
categories.nameEn: Key Terms from the Story of Noah in Surah Al-Mu'minun

items.verse: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
items.verseEn: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
[Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."

items.verse: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ ۙ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّۢ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَـٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
items.verseEn: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into it [i.e., the ship] from each [creature] two mates and your family, except him for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.

items.verse: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
items.verseEn: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allāh who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'

harf.hint: The disbelievers falsely claimed the Prophet ﷺ composed this art form — but Surah Ya-Sin declares he was never taught it
harf.arabicVerse: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
harf.verse: 36:69 - And We did not give him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur’ān

deduction.title: The Veiled Believer in the Tyrant's Court
deduction.intro: Within the gilded halls of the most arrogant ruler known to the Quran — where defiance of the Divine defined every edict — one soul walked among the privileged, hiding the most dangerous of secrets in plain sight. This individual carried a faith so forbidden within those walls that its discovery would mean certain death. Yet conviction burned like a flame beneath the ashes, and when the moment arrived, truth rang out with a courage that shook the very foundation of the tyrant's palace.
clues: I lived among the inner circle of the most powerful and arrogant ruler of my time, surrounded by luxury and influence.
I concealed my true belief deep within my heart, fearing for my life from those who ruled with cruelty and oppression.
When my people doubted and wavered in the face of truth, I stepped forward to warn them of the tragic fate that had befallen past nations who rejected their Lord's messengers.
I reminded my people of the story of a beloved young dreamer who was cast down by his own kin yet rose to great authority in a distant land.
I urged my people not to obey the ruler who led them astray, instead inviting them to follow me along the path of righteousness and guidance.
I openly spoke the truth even though the tyrant's followers threatened to stone me or expel me from the land.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: The Hidden Believer from Pharaoh's Family
A Patient Patriarch Who Wept Blind Until His Son Returned
A Faithful Servant Whose Skin Disease Was Eventually Cured
A Sinful Son Who Rejected a Prophet's Invitation to Board the Ark
A Ruthless Tyrant Who Claimed Divinity for Themselves
identity.answer: The Hidden Believer from Pharaoh's Family

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Concealing faith in a tyrant's court
Suffering blindness from years of weeping
Being tested by the loss of family and severe affliction
Building a great ship while being ridiculed
Enduring the scorching heat of a great fire
trial.answer: Concealing faith in a tyrant's court

location.label: Key Element
options: Pharaoh's palace
A mountain peak where an ark was constructed
A sacred valley beneath Mount Sinai
A magnificent garden with two flowing streams
A crystal throne above an underground river

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Divine protection while the oppressors met their destruction
Was reunited with family after decades of separation
Was granted patience, restored health, and a larger family
Was saved on a boat while the rest of the world drowned
Was rescued unharmed from flames by the command of Allah
outcome.answer: Divine protection while the oppressors met their destruction

deduction.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُونِ أَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ
deduction.verse: And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me; I will guide you to the way of right conduct. (40:38)

scramble.hint: A profound rhetorical question about the purpose of creation and our return to Allah for accountability on the Day of Judgment.
scramble.arabic: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ عَبَثًۭا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
scramble.verseEn: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"
